fact_summary: EMR7.8.0 lists Hadoop3.4.1, Scala2.12.18, Spark3.5.4-amzn-0 and default Corretto17; standard support through2027-03-06. Candidate justification only, not regional account availability.
YARN conf directory, client versus cluster mode, prebuilt with-Hadoop classpath isolation and spark.yarn.archive/jars are documented. Hosted3.5.4 page404; pinned Apache source was read instead.
Bootstrap runs before managed applications; nonzero causes instance failure/reallocation and may terminate cluster. Shutdown hooks are not guaranteed on node errors.
Private subnet and S3gateway endpoint support, required AWS buckets/ALrepo reachability, distinct service-access security group; release8 control-plane endpoint change is not assumed for7.8.
Restricted S3endpoint policy must allow required EMR and AmazonLinux buckets, not merely project artifacts.
Private managed primary/core/service-access group distinctions and EMR-managed rule additions must be accounted for.
Access point constrains root and POSIX identity; mount target is required and security group attaches there.
IAM ClientMount/ClientWrite and file system policy can scope access; default anonymous policy is unsuitable; TLS/accesspoint condition keys exist.
EFS mount helper supports TLS for NFS transport; its local mount watchdog is not an EMR lifetime controller.
EMR symmetricKMS must be regional; node profile and EMRservice role have different encryption permissions, including EBS-related grants.
Auto-termination responds to idleness; busy YARN jobs are not covered. Metricscollector publicAPI access requirements matter in private subnet.
Termination is asynchronous and described as taking1–5minutes depending on configuration, not an instantaneousbillingstop guarantee.
EMR documents conditional TerminateJobFlows via elasticmapreduce:ResourceTag and warns tag mutation can bypass intent. Example policies are demonstrations, not production policies.
Scheduleprecision60seconds, not hard realtime; fixedUTC avoidsDST ambiguity.
Universal targets specify SDK service/action with execution role; read-only actions are unsupported. Lambda may perform required readback.
Throttledinvocations may be delayed; publisheddefaults are not observed accountquota headroom.
Retry behavior depends on synchronous/asynchronousinvoker and may delay; idempotence is necessary.
Authentication/RPC encryption/spill settings and YARN per-application secret distribution depend on secure YARN RPC. Customruntime mustconfigure explicitly.
EMRsecurityconfiguration covers specificmanagedstorage/transit mechanisms; do not assume customSpark inheritsmanageddefaults.
Elasticmeteringincludes metadata/dataand minimumNFSrequestbytes; currentpage also listsOneZoneElastic. RecommendRegional forproposal without claimingOneZoneunsupported.
